item.title: Conservative Anglican leaders meet in Nigeria, facing debate on a possible breakaway
item.description: The outlook for the Anglican Communion, one of the world’s largest families of Christian churches, remains uncertain, but some answers may emerge by the end of this week.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV renews calls for peace, dialogue as Iran strikes continue
item.description: The pope called for people everywhere “to truly strive to promote dialogue” and “seek solutions – to resolve problems without weapons.”

item.title: Rhode Island AG to unveil long-awaited report on Diocese of Providence clergy abuse
item.description: Rhode Island Attorney General Peter Neronha will release on Wednesday findings from a multiyear investigation into child sexual abuse in the Diocese of Providence.

item.title: Leading Vatican official says war in the Middle East could cause world ‘being set ablaze’
item.description: A “preventative war” could make the whole world at “risk being set ablaze,” according to the Vatican’s chief diplomat.

item.title: Spanish actress’s public attack on Church shows “uneasy conscience”
item.description: Comic actress Silvia Abril made her remarks during a red carpet interview at the 2026 Goya Awards – the "Spanish Oscars" – on February 28 in Barcelona.

item.title: New lawsuit challenges restrictions on school choice in Vermont’s education reform law
item.description: Two parents from Georgia, Vermont, have filed a lawsuit challenging the state’s education reform law, claiming it arbitrarily violates their children’s access to private school and limits their educational opportunity.

item.title: Government funds Hilo Catholic shelter without safety exits
item.description: An emergency shelter for women in Hilo with funding from the state and county hasn’t been inspected by county fire inspectors since it opened five years ago, and the bedrooms lack the required emergency exits.

item.title: Claims of ‘rediscovered’ Michelangelos unsettle Renaissance experts
item.description: An independent researcher claimed on Wednesday that a marble bust of Christ in a Roman church is by Michelangelo, the latest purported attribution to the Renaissance genius who is one of the most imitated artists in the world.

item.title: Sprawling investigation finds decades of sexual abuse among Catholic priests in Rhode Island
item.description: New report says Catholic priests in Rhode Island preyed on hundreds of children for decades, getting away with sexual abuse largely due to a system where bishops prioritized minimizing scandal.
